summary: Changed pipeline.py normalize(images) to compute each image's population mean and variance independently and apply (pixel - mean) / sqrt(variance + 1e-5). The function preserves nested list shape and input data, returns [] for an empty batch, and raises ValueError for any empty image. Added and ran validate_cpu.py: all 7 CPU tests passed, covering manually derived reference values, unrelated-image insertion and batch reordering, separate-image equivalence, shape and nonmutation, constant and singleton images, empty inputs, and 100 seeded finite-valued fixtures. This evidence supports the specified deterministic per-image normalization behavior on the tested CPU fixtures only.
unverified: Stochastic augmentation equivalence was not tested or established by these deterministic statistics checks.
No GPU execution, performance benchmark, or production-training validation was performed.
Non-finite values, extreme floating-point overflow, and inputs outside batches of flat numeric lists were not validated.
